item.title: Chinese LLM Resource and Cost Comparison: GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, DeepSeek, Qwen, Doubao, Xiaomi MiMo
item.description:
Overview

This post was first published in 2026-03 comparing GLM-5 / Kimi K2.5 / MiniMax M2.7; the 2026-09 edition covers seven vendors in four roles: the flagship trio (GLM-5.3 / Kimi K3 / MiniMax M3), the price anchors (DeepSeek, Qwen), the highest-volume Doubao, and the new challenger (Xiaomi MiMo). Data is as of 2026-09-23, using public list prices — every vendor repriced multiple times this year, so check the official pricing pages before you buy.
